news.title: To dive or not to dive? Football's big dilemma
news.description: Liverpool feel Alexander Isak should have been awarded a penalty against Arsenal but with the striker not appealing for the decision and the VAR staying out of it, should he have made more of it?

news.title: Villa drop legal action threat against Carragher
news.description: Aston Villa will not move forward with any legal action towards Jamie Carragher.

news.title: Bottom club Sunderland to stick with manager Le Bris
news.description: Sunderland manager Regis le Bris is set to be given more time to turn things around despite his side's poor start to the Premier League season.

news.title: I'll tell my players to dive in future - Iraola
news.description: Andoni Iraola says that he will tell his players to go down in future after Liverpool were denied a penalty in Sunday's defeat by Arsenal.

news.title: No Grealish, no problem - the rise of Everton's youngsters
news.description: BBC Sport examines the growing influence of Everton's youngsters on their chances of success this season.

news.title: Hellberg unsure of 'brilliant' Lankshear's England chances
news.description: Head coach Kim Hellberg hails Will Lankshear a "brilliant lad" as the goals keep coming, raising questions of a possible England call-up.

news.title: From Fleetwood embarrassment to 'magical' Anfield win 14 years in making
news.description: Arsenal bounce back from the low of defeat at League Two Fleetwood to secure their first win in 14 years at Anfield - and open up a three-point lead at the top of the Premier League.

news.title: Arsenal move clear at the top with a rare win at Liverpool
news.description: Arsenal win at Anfield for the first time since 2012 to earn a three-point lead at the top of the Premier League table following an end-to-end match that leaves Liverpool frustrated to have taken nothing.

news.title: Trailing 8-0 & down to six players - abandoned game labelled a 'farce'
news.description: A non-league game abandoned after one team was reduced to six players while trailing 8-0 is labelled "a complete farce".

news.title: Hibs toast win over Hearts - but will they kick on before cup final?
news.description: Hibernian buried their Hampden hoodoo against city rivals Heart of Midlothian on Sunday, but will they build on their Premier Sports Cup semi-final triumph?
